public.points_tip: The Hamyan points system is designed to reward your real activities. Daily login records daily points. Reading a blog article to the end records points once. Buying and reading/completing books in the library gives points. Buying academy training packages and related activity gives points. Posting, liking, and commenting in the Hamyan Community also gives points. Points are calculated based on system rules such as daily limits, non duplicate actions, and completion conditions.

website.terms_intro: Preface: In this text, the Hamyan system is referred to as the platform.

terms_sections.title: 1. Terms for Store Owners
items: Store owners must provide accurate and valid information and are responsible for the correctness of submitted data.
Incorrect data entry or system abuse may result in account restrictions or suspension.
Users are responsible for correctly recording transactions, income, expenses, and reports.
Store owners must communicate responsibly with customers and manage orders on time.

terms_sections.title: 2. Terms for Buyers
items: Buyers may purchase according to platform rules and must provide accurate contact and payment information.
Payments must be made through secure and approved methods.
If there is an issue with an order or payment, users must use official support channels.
Protecting buyer personal information is one of the platform's top priorities.

terms_sections.title: 3. Terms for Marketers
items: Marketers must use legal and ethical methods to promote products and services.
Misleading advertisements or activities against rules may lead to access restrictions.
Commission and payment details are calculated and displayed according to transparent system policies.

terms_common_items: The platform only provides service infrastructure, and direct transaction responsibility lies with the involved users.
By using the system, all users accept compliance with rules and regulations.
Any harmful, deceptive, or illegal use of services is prohibited.
website.policies_page_intro: Hamyan is a product of Ulanish and follows the Ulanish privacy policy. Using the service means accepting that policy. Account deletion requests are submitted at https://ulanish.dev/account-deletion?app=ishanch.
website.privacy_policy_intro: Hamyan belongs to Ulanish and follows the Ulanish privacy policy at https://ulanish.dev/privacy.
privacy_policy_items: The applicable privacy policy is the Ulanish policy: https://ulanish.dev/privacy
We only collect essential information such as name, contact number, and profile details to deliver services better.
First name, last name, profile photo, and other public posts in the Hamyan community section are visible to the public.
User information is confidential and is not sold or transferred to third parties without user consent, except where required by law.
For account security, data is protected with suitable technical measures and we work to prevent unauthorized access.
Users are responsible for keeping their password secure and must not share login credentials with others.
Some data may be analyzed to improve service quality without exposing personal identity.
privacy_user_rights_items: Users can request correction or updates of inaccurate account information.
Users can ask the support team how their information is being used.
Financial accounts are held with Ulanish, so financial records are retained. Account deletion requests are submitted at https://ulanish.dev/account-deletion?app=ishanch.
website.privacy_contact_note: Submit an account deletion request at https://ulanish.dev/account-deletion?app=ishanch. Privacy questions follow the Ulanish policy at https://ulanish.dev/privacy.
